title: Structured Approval Host Block After Capability Split
claim: After FP-MCP-345 capability-separated tools were deployed and FP-MCP-346 was admitted, ChatGPT allowed read-only observe and packet checkpoint recording but blocked a structured approval recorder call for the real FP-MCP-295 execution tuple.
summary: Record the host-platform block encountered when retrying forgepilot_record_structured_human_approval for FP-MCP-346 scoped to FP-MCP-295, after a successful forgepilot_observe_next_gate live probe and successful FP-MCP-346 packet creation.
caveats: The blocked call occurred before ForgePilot tool invocation completed, so no approval artifact was created.
This does not invalidate the read-only observe probe, which succeeded.
This does not test preview_clearance_creation or record_clearance_intent because no fresh committed approval was available.
The context may have been hot after previous gate/approval discussion.
boundaries: No approval artifact created by the blocked call.

structuredRecord.observation: host safety blocked structured approval recorder call for real execution tuple after capability-separated observe succeeded
structuredRecord.hypothesisUpdate: Capability-separated read-only observe is accepted, but approval artifact creation for the real tuple may still trip host safety in a hot context.
